Interface HasAsyncItems<C,S>

Type Parameters:
C - the type of the component used for method chaining
S - the type of the items
All Known Implementing Classes:
FinderColumn, MenuList, TreeViewItem
public interface HasAsyncItems<C,S>
Represents a component that can asynchronously load and manage items.

The async lifecycle has three operations:

  • load() — first-time fetch, only runs when status is AsyncStatus.pending, idempotent
  • refresh() — re-fetch while keeping old items visible, then swap atomically
  • reset() — clear all items and go back to AsyncStatus.pending without fetching
